verdict.rationale: Maritime's own SDK is built to provision one agent per end user, idempotently on `externalId`. Each agent or computer runs in its own micro-VM, which supports running fleets of isolated per-user environments. The only documented limits are plan-level agent counts (a set number of agents per subscription, 3 on the free plan), not concurrency limits, and nothing shows how many run at large scale. Missing for 10: documented concurrent-execution limits or quotas, large-scale fleet benchmarks or independent corroboration, and rate limits for bulk provisioning.
